replacement_protocol.restart_policy: rerun all 600 cases for all 3 repeats from case 1 for both arms
replacement_protocol.validity_requirement: zero API errors, zero empty decisions, zero retry-completion length truncations; recovered first-call truncations are reported as runtime defects

rationale: One reference stop-branch completion still reached 768 tokens before a successful parser retry. A 2048-token ceiling reduces censoring while retaining a bounded response contract. Because a model may emit a nonterminating malformed string at any finite ceiling, the deployed Planner retry is part of the evaluated runtime: recovered first-call truncations are counted, while retry truncation or final error/empty output invalidates the run.
